card.name: Start of drug names in interaction lists
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a drug or herb name in drug-interaction text, most often the 'w' in St. John's wort. Also fires on small words inside dose phrases.

modes.label: St. John's wort
modes.description: The 'w' that begins 'wort' after St. John's in lists of inducers.

modes.label: Drug name starts after a colon
modes.description: The first letter or piece of a named drug listed after a drug class and colon.

modes.label: Dose phrase words
modes.description: A small word inside a dose or use phrase in an interaction table.
modes.example: Posaconazole 200 mg once<< a>> day for 10 days 3
